 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Coventry's substitutions have added something and the hosts are the better side at the moment.
 Fulham respond with a couple of changes now as César Palacios and Rodrigo Muniz come on for Gonzalo García and Alex Iwobi.

 'Do you think Arteta will care?' published at 16:31 BST 16:31 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Celtic striker on Final Score 
 With all the games coming thick and fast, there's been a lot made around Arsenal's recent performances, have they been good to watch? Not really. 
 Football and winning is about finding a way like they have done this afternoon. Two goals from the centre half's, do you think Mikel Arteta will care? 
 385 111 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:31 BST 16:31 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 David Moyes looks to his bench for the first time and sends on Tyler Dibling for Brennan Johnson.
 The former Spurs winger struggled to get into the game.
 In fact, it's going to be a double change as Vitalii Mykolenko has gone down and won't be able to continue. On comes Hayden Hackney. James Garner will slot in at left-back from the looks of it.
 80 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:30 BST 16:30 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 A bit of worry for Fulham as Jack Rudoni's corner is headed down into the dangerzone by Stephen Mfuni, but Bernd Leno is quickly able to take charge and dive on the ball.
 33 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:29 BST 16:29 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 "Champions of England, we know what we are!" sing the Arsenal fans.
 With this two-goal cushion, they're feeling much more secure. The Gunners look set to go level on points with Manchester City at the top of the table.
 419 100 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That could be over' published at 16:28 BST 16:28 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Kai Havertz was ready for the knockdown but he got a shout and the big defender came up behind him and it was the easiest knockdown you can imagine at that backpost. 
 He could have closed his eyes and finished that one off. Two nil and you imagine that could be over. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 387 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:27 BST 16:27 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Better from Fulham as Timothy Castagne sends a header from a cross just wide.
 Coventry make a triple change now as Frank Onyeka, Taiwo Awoniyi and Ephron Mason-Clark come on. They replace Brandon Thomas-Asante, Sidiki Cherif and Caleb Yirenkyi.
 68 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Arsenal 2-0 Everton published at 16:27 BST 16:27 BST 
 Gabriel (68 mins) 
 Arsenal double their lead and it's the man who looked like he was going off just a few minutes ago!
 It's the two milestone men who combine as Ben White, on his 200th Arsenal appearance, clips the ball to the far post.
 Gabriel is there waiting and heads home to mark his 200th Premier League game with a goal.
 Surely, that puts the game beyond Everton?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1783 457 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 16:26 BST 16:26 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Triple change for Arsenal before the corner is taken.
 Myles Lewis-Skelly, Mikel Merino and Viktor Gyokeres head on.
 On come Riccardo Calafiori, Bruno Guimaraes and Kai Havertz.
 316 73 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:25 BST 16:25 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Arsenal threaten to create an opening as Mikel Merino is found in space on the edge of the box.
 However, James Tarkowski flies out towards him and blocks the shot. The ball spins behind for a corner.
 155 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 16:24 BST 16:24 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 It's all getting very scrappy and a bit tetchy at the Emirates.
 James Garner is the latest player to be booked for a late tackle on Mikel Merino.
 177 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:23 BST 16:23 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter at Emirates Stadium 
 A yellow for Mikel Arteta - he'd been in a debate for a while with the fourth official about staying in his technical area.
 222 163 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 16:23 BST 16:23 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Viktor Gyokeres is adjudged to have fouled James Tarkowski. Everton have a free-kick and a chance to get the ball into the box.
 Gyokores is furious and for a moment it seems as though he is going to be booked for dissent.
 But referee Tony Harrington walks straight past him and books Mikel Arteta instead. The Arsenal boss has been straying outside of his technical area for a change.
 174 158 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Team news - Joao Pedro out, Quenda in for Chelsea; Fernandes starts for Spurs published at 16:22 BST 16:22 BST 
 Chelsea v Tottenham (17:30 BST) 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport senior football reporter at Stamford Bridge 
 Striker Joao Pedro is a shock absentee for Chelsea and is replaced by young winger Geovany Quenda, with Morgan Rogers likely to lead the line.
 It will be Quenda's first start for Chelsea in any competition.
 Young goalkeeper Mike Penders comes in for Emiliano Martinez after the Argentine suffered a fractured jaw in the 2-0 win at Everton last weekend.
 Chelsea XI : Penders, Acheampong, Lacroix, Colwill, Neto, Caicedo, Henderson, Hato, Rogers, Palmer, Quenda
 Subs: Sharman-Lowe, Fofana, Gusto, Palestra, Nicoll-Jazuli, Barco, Lacia, Estevao, Welbeck
 Midfielder Mateus Fernandes comes in for the injured Tosin Adarabioyo, denying the defender a reunion with his former club.
 Winger Matys Tel also starts in place of striker Dominic Solanke, who is among the substitutes.
 James Maddison was a doubt but has been deemed fit enough to start by manager Roberto De Zerbi.
 Tottenham XI : Kinsky, Gray, Van Hecke, Van de Ven, Robertson, Tonali, Fernandes, Kudus, Maddison, Marmoush, Tel
 Subs: Dubravka, Pedro Porro, Senesi, Davies, Olusesi, Gallagher, Kulusevski, Williams-Barnett, Solanke

 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 We've just passed the hour mark and Fulham make a change as Hugo Larsson is replaced by Sander Berge.
 32 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Arsenal 'see the danger here' published at 16:20 BST 16:20 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 The pace has come up a bit from Arsenal, they're passing it much, much quicker and I think they see the danger here. 
 Everton have created next to nothing in clear-cut chances but that doesn't matter - they only need one and they only need to take one. 
 248 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:19 BST 16:19 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Gabriel seems to be fine as he gets into a tussle with Thierno Barry, plenty of shirt pulling from both but Arsenal get the free-kick.
 No clear chances as yet since half-time.
 128 87 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:19 BST 16:19 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Bobby Thomas cannot continue for Coventry so he is replaced by 18-year-old on-loan Manchester City defender Stephen Mfuni.
 26 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Pickford isn't great at coming out for crosses' published at 16:18 BST 16:18 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 There's elements of Jordan Pickford's game where he excels. I think shot stopping long range shots, he's quick off his line at times. 
 But what you're trying to do as an Arsenal team is exploit his weaknesses. I don't think he's the greatest at coming out for crosses. 
 If you look at the way Arsenal have set up they're arcing a circle around him so he can't come out to get any crosses. 
 Image source, Getty Images

 get involved Get Involved published at 16:17 BST 16:17 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 How much are Everton missing Grealish and Branthwaite! In an already stretched squad, it inherently makes Arsenal away a tougher task.
